tcs.tc_title: Short press on the preset button triggers Preset Select
tcs.test_item: The HU shall trigger Preset Select function when it identifies a short press event on the preset button
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. Preset 3 is set to a receivable station whose frequency differs from the currently tuned frequency
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the tuned frequency
2. Short press the preset 3 button
3. Read the tuned frequency
4. Read the content of preset 3
tcs.expected_result:
1. The frequency tuned before the press is displayed
2. The short press is identified and the Preset Select function starts
3. The HU is tuned to the frequency stored in preset 3
4. The content of preset 3 is unchanged by the short press
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
